title: the Sundered Sea Rising Revisited
author: Wren Ishikawa
blurb: Cyrus Oyelaran, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
